# Babel tests we consciously skip.
# These are intentional language differences, not bugs.
#
# Format:
#   # comment explaining why tests below are skipped
#   test-name-1
#   test-name-2
#
#   another-test # inline comment also works

# Legacy <T>x type assertion syntax - use `x as T` instead
# See DESIGN.md - we don't support this in .ds files (TSX ambiguity)
typescript/cast/type-assertion
typescript/cast/type-assertion-after-operator
typescript/cast/type-assertion-and-assign
typescript/cast/type-assertion-before-operator
typescript/cast/parenthesized-type-assertion-and-assign

# Destack allows namespace declarations without `declare` prefix
# In TypeScript, `namespace` alone after ASI would be an identifier, but Destack
# treats it as a valid namespace declaration keyword (more permissive)
typescript/module-namespace/module-declare-new-line
typescript/module-namespace/namespace-declare-new-line
